# WatermarkOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`Watermark`](watermark.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type WatermarkOptions = Partial<Omit<Pick<Watermark, (typeof WATERMARK_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'color' | 'fontSize'>> & {
    /** Font size. Accepts a length: `72`, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    fontSize?: LengthInput;
    /** Text colour. Accepts a palette token (`'slate-400'`) or hex. */
    color?: ColorInput;
}
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Text colour.
- [`fontName`](#fontname): Font family name for the watermark text (default: "Helvetica").
- [`fontSize`](#fontsize): Font size.
- [`opacity`](#opacity): Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque).
- [`rotationDegrees`](#rotationdegrees): Rotation angle in degrees.
- [`text`](#text): The watermark text to display (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL").

### `color`

```typescript
color?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Text colour. Accepts a palette token (`'slate-400'`) or hex.

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Font family name for the watermark text (default: "Helvetica").

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Font size. Accepts a length: `72`, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `opacity`

```typescript
opacity?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque). Default: 0.15.

### `rotationDegrees`

```typescript
rotationDegrees?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Rotation angle in degrees. Negative values rotate counter-clockwise. Default: -45 (diagonal from bottom-left to top-right).

### `text`

```typescript
text?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The watermark text to display (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL").
